t.t-esc: t('Rebuild Fact and Budget Analytical Views')

div.p: Executes the full 5-step analytical view compilation pipeline: (1) Validates schema prerequisites: Checks ERP feed tables, product categories, machine unit tags ('02'), and budget tables. (2) Restores master taxonomy & product tags: Reconnects category family relations and product gating tags. (3) Attributes salesman targets: Populates salesman and territory assignments on multi-year sales_budget_line without target inflation. (4) Recompiles and populates materialized views: Drops, recompiles, and fully repopulates the unified 11-level fact table (v_pbi_sales_sman_fact) and budget helpers via init(). (5) Diagnostic verification: Audits module dependencies and schema health.

t.t-esc: t('Verify Links, Gaps and Data Alignments')

div.p: Comprehensive read-only validation suite in three parts: (A) Master links & gaps audit — audits all 10 dimensions (Sales Type Group, Partner Classification, Region, City, Salesman, Customer, Main Category, Sub-Category, Product Group, Product Sub-Group) across This Year, Last Year, and Target. (B) Target vs actuals alignment — validates that every category and region with sales has a corresponding budget target. (C) Snapshot coverage & totals — reports in-scope sales volumes, quantities, and record counts.
